title: Judaayi
desc: Javed Akhtar says we humans are so caught up in our personal lives that we don't realise the entire world is flooded with many problems. We talk about them for some time & then go back to our normal lives.

title: Sukoon
desc: Javed Akhtar says our lives are moving so quickly that the destinations are being left far behind. In this fast-paced life we need to take breaks more often to enjoy the small moments of life.

title: Chaand Aur Sooraj
desc: Javed Akhtar tells that today we know so much more about nature to the extent that we have cut off an emotional attachment with it. Do you remember the last time you peeked out of your windows or went on your rooftops to see the moon?

title: Ghum
desc: Javed Akhtar tells how the path of life can lead you to various destinations and explains minute details about human relations and human interactions. He says that the journey of life is different for all.

title: Duniya
desc: Javed Akhtar explains how water can be associated with various aspects of life. It is sometimes used to explain depth, power & at times happiness as well.

title: Yaad
desc: Javed Akhtar says trees have been an integral part of mankind & suggests the use of tree to depict various aspects of life - exploitation, hibernation, bearing fruits of success, hope & companionship.

title: Waqt
desc: Javed Akhtar says ustad shayars usually despised prejudice, strongly held traditions, superstitions in their couplets and wrote more about humanity, companionship, friendship and love in one's life.

title: Aawargi
desc: Javed Akhtar compares life to a budding flower; he further says there are many elements that are waiting to prevent it from blossoming. We therefore must focus on how to protect it & help it grow beautifully.

title: Barbaad
desc: Barbaad

title: Sailaab
desc: Javed Akhtar explains the expression of emotions in a wide range. He says people who do not overtly express their emotions, leave room for more interpretation, empathy and genuine compassion.

title: Zindagi Ke Shabo
desc: Javed Akhtar talks about the history of Rails being used as a metaphor in poetries. Rails have been used to symbolise prosperity, development and at times to symbolise the journey of life.

title: Qasid
desc: Javed Akhtar says in olden times a qasid i.e. messenger used to deliver messages across villages. People used to deliver their messages to each other through these messengers which arose the essence of life.

title: Rehguzar
desc: Javed Akhtar, takes us through various shayaaris where Sharaab is used as a symbol to explain a concept that talks about various examples of life.

title: Paani Pyas
desc: Javed Akhtar talks about the word 'Awaaz' and its various forms, the one that we use to talk to others, the one that we raise as an opinion and the one that is within us.

title: Shajar
desc: Javed Akhtar says every human has some thoughts & expectations from life. He further says life is a formation of various elements & is full of ups & downs while death is a destruction of these elements.
